heading: Offences in respect of Appeal Tribunal
content:
53B.
Offences in respect of Appeal Tribunal
Any person who—
(a)
refuses or fails without reasonable excuse to comply with any lawful order, requirement or direction made or given by the Appeal Tribunal or the Chairman; or
(b)
disturbs or otherwise interferes with the proceedings of the Appeal Tribunal,
commits an offence and is liable to a fine at level 3 and to imprisonment for 6 months.
(Amended 20 of 2008 s. 30)
